The '''Klasse Ephemora system''' consisted of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Klasse Ephemora (star)|Klasse Ephemora]] and the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mobus/Legends|Mobus]]. It was named after the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Klasse Ephemora (explorer)|Klasse Ephemora]], who discovered it several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located on the far side of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].

It was around Mobus that the living planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] orbited for nearly 50 years, from before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion.
